API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingRegion Info Resource Get Regions By Prefix
Region Info Resource Get Regions By Prefix
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/region/search

Retrieves the list of cities (along with their geographical data) that match the prefix search. The geographical data includes the latitude and longitude coordinates of the city, geographical ID of the city and state, country, postal code, etc.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
prefix
string

The string used in the prefix search of the city or region. The prefix can contain names of city, state, country in the following format: city name, state name, country name. A phrase for city name is mandatory, whereas the state and country names can be optionally provided to narrow down the search results.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100 and the maximum size is 1,000.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
cityGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the city

stateGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the state

latitude
double

The latitude coordinate of the city

longitude
double

The longitude coordinate of the city

cityName
string

The name of the city

stateName
string

The name of the state, province, or territory of a country

countryName
string

The name of the country

countryCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter country code

postalCode
string

The postal code

continentCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter continent code

]
